name: Whova
description: Whova is an event-management platform for registration, agendas, attendee engagement, event apps, websites, onsite operations, networking, exhibitors, sponsors, hybrid delivery and post-event workflows.
agentUseSummary: Whova is visible as a provider-partnership preview. Relay will not request credentials or expose agent actions until Whova supplies a supported multi-customer authorization and API contract.

capabilities.label: Access authorized event data
capabilities.description: After Whova approves Relay and documents a supported contract, expose only the event-management capabilities, accounts and fields authorized by that contract.

blocked.label: Connect before provider partnership
blocked.description: Relay has not received a supported multi-customer authorization or integration contract from Whova.

blocked.label: Use undocumented Whova endpoints
blocked.description: Relay will not discover, scrape or call undocumented endpoints; Whova's terms expressly prohibit attempting to discover undocumented APIs.

blocked.label: Collect Whova login or session credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not collect an organizer password, cookie, browser session or mobile token as a substitute for supported provider authorization.

blocked.label: Run Whova agent actions before contract review
blocked.description: No event, attendee, agenda, registration, communication, engagement, analytics or administrative action is callable until Whova documents the permitted production surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider partnership required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable until Whova provides a supported authorization and API contract that Relay can review and implement.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until Whova supplies and approves a supported production integration contract.
No Hermes tools are callable until Whova supplies and approves a supported production integration contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Whova's public integration material describes product-managed integrations, Zapier and a partner inquiry, but it does not publish the authentication method, endpoints, schemas, permissions, limits or distribution terms needed for a Relay account connector. Whova's terms prohibit attempting to discover undocumented APIs.
providerSetup.nextAction: Use Whova's official partner inquiry to request a written multi-customer authorization and API contract for Relay Console. If Whova approves it, review the permitted accounts, scopes, endpoints, limits, data handling, revocation and distribution terms before implementing bounded tools and running separate provider-console acceptance.

evidence.supports: Whova lists product-managed CRM, association, marketing, calendar, streaming and Zapier integrations and invites prospective integrations to become partners; the public page does not publish a general account API contract.
Whova's terms prohibit using integrations beyond documented endpoints, limits and scopes and prohibit attempting to discover undocumented APIs.
Whova documents organizer-dashboard agenda management and website embedding as product features rather than a supported third-party account API.
